verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a rich programmatic surface — core operations (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget), a CLI, an MCP server, and a REST 'API reference' exposed via Docker on port 8000 — giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. However, a live probe for a machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404 on all candidate paths, so the REST API itself lacks a discoverable public schema even though the Python/CLI/MCP surfaces are well documented. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger spec for the REST API, and independent hands-on confirmation of REST endpoint usage beyond the SDK/CLI.
